headline: Nifty Ends Flat Ahead Of Fed Decision
bias_text: Indian benchmark indices ended flat after a volatile session, with the Nifty 50 dropping 0.02% to close at 22,749.75 and the Sensex declining 0.01% to 73,598.67. Upside momentum was capped by elevated crude oil prices and caution ahead of the US Federal Reserve decision. Meanwhile, broader markets showed resilience as the Nifty 500 managed a gain of 0.58%.

vix.headline: India VIX 16.40 (-4.43%)
vix.text: India VIX declined by 4.43% to settle at 16.40, reflecting a decrease in market volatility expectations. The USD/INR exchange rate fell by 0.09% to stand at 95.11.

asia.head: Asian Stocks Advance On AI
asia.text: Asian markets traded higher, driven by South Korea's Kospi jumping 5.73% following SK Hynix results and Japan's Nikkei 225 rising 1.30%. US equities gained as the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.18%, while the US 10-year treasury yield moved to 4.99%.
